description_en: traditional fish creel with woven body, empty inner cavity and small top trap lid; front plain toggle latch, right side strap anchor, rear broad padded carrying panel
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image is the canonical FRONT. Render ONE photorealistic RIGHT-SIDE azimuth90, exact profile of THAT EXACT SAME OBJECT, rotating only the camera. Right shoulder-strap anchor nearest camera. Front toggle turned away toward image-left and edge-on. Preserve two straps and domed top trap lid. Keep exact material, finish, weave, dimensions, bindings, handles, cavities and natural resting/display pose of the reference. Match sensible elevation, warm-white seamless background, soft light, scale and framing. Whole object centered with margins. No three-quarter azimuth, mirroring, detached objects, props, people, food, animals or plants. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermark or measurements.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
